profile.visual_desc: Humanoid in full grey plate armor, spiked pauldrons, smooth T-visor helmet, red collar accents, and an orange tabard.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Facing right. Close-up of a grey full-plate helmet with a prominent black T-shaped visor completely concealing the face. Red neck accent visible.
profile.weapon_desc: Curved silver sword wielded in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Faces down-right. Stands with legs spread, holding the curved sword high over the right shoulder.
profile.step2_windup: Leans back slightly, raising the sword to its peak height to gather momentum.
profile.step3_impact: Swings diagonally downward, unleashing a massive, thick golden-yellow crescent energy wave that arcs widely across the front.
profile.step4_finish: Sword follows through to the lower left. The golden arc dissipates into a small ground wisp before the unit resets its stance.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: Frame 4 must display a large, thick golden-yellow crescent energy wave sweeping diagonally downward in front of the unit.

evaluation.diagnosis: Sequence aligns with reference frames. Biomechanics and crescent VFX timing are consistent.
